output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.

The transferFrom function uses `msg.sender` as a parameter, which is not a contract and can be easily manipulated. This allows attackers.create.value(2 + _extraData.length) + _extraData to create a valid `false` boolean value, devaluating the `transferFrom` function.
The transfer function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, which can be used for malicious purposes.
